question: What could hynek/stamina (X) reuse from searxng/searxng (Y) at c15647b5a5921858d5147d291c658fbda3cba12c, in particular outgoing-request resilience (searx/network/, engine suspension after errors)? For each reusable mechanism: code references pinned to a commit; whether and how it can be reused.

S1.title: LICENSE (GNU Affero General Public License v3), searxng

S14.title: searx/settings_defaults.py (schema defaults for suspended_times, retries, timeouts)

claims.text: The licence of searxng (Y) at the pinned commit is GNU AGPL version 3.

searxng keeps a SuspendedStatus (end time, reason, continuous-error counter, lock) per engine network, checks it before each search and resets it on success; at this commit the continuous-error counter is incremented but never enters the ban duration, so the ban is constant.
searxng settings.yml sets ban_time_on_fail to 5 seconds and max_ban_time_on_fail to 120 seconds.
In online.py, SSL errors, timeouts, request exceptions and the access-denied-family exceptions suspend the engine, while a bare Exception is only recorded.
Three exception classes in searx/exceptions.py carry a suspended_time with a per-class default.
Stamina TryAgain accepts an after parameter, a wait hint inside one call.
A search of stamina source finds no suspension or circuit-breaker code; the retry loop is stateless per call. Verdict of Finding 1 (cross-call suspension of a failing target): WATCH (seam missing).
raise_for_httperror maps HTTP 402 and 403 to the access-denied exception and 429 to the too-many-requests exception.
searx/settings_defaults.py gives schema defaults of 86400 seconds (access denied), 86400 (captcha) and 3600 (too many requests), whereas settings.yml gives 180, 3600 and 180.
searx/network/__init__.py _get_timeout subtracts the elapsed time from the timeout (timeout -= default_timer() - start_time).

Stamina stops its retry loop with stop_before_delay(timeout), default timeout 45.0 seconds, so it bounds only the whole loop. Verdict of Finding 4 (propagating the remaining time budget into each attempt): WATCH.
Verdict of Finding 3 (network retries with client, proxy and source-IP rotation): NO-GO; the retry loop retries immediately with no sleep and is tied to Y's Network object.
Verdict of Finding 5 (error recording keyed by code location): NO-GO; ErrorContext relies on inspect.trace() frame inspection and Y's engine registry.

Verdict of Finding 6 (composite capability, target-health registry, an inference): WATCH; the pieces share the target key and the suspension flow, the seam is missing, and the licence of the assembly is AGPL hence clean-room only.

conclusion: searxng's AGPL licence blocks copying and its suspension is constant, not escalating, so the only worthwhile borrowings are clean-room ideas, chiefly an opt-in target-suspension registry (WATCH).
